g.text: Worktrees are cheap, they are just folders. One folder per initiative, one worktree per track, one Claude session per worktree.
Apple Silicon eats dozens of logical DBs
Since LLMs are very slow, you don't want to sit staring at the screen.
Two or three sessions in parallel, each one with its isolated worktree.
Real prompt, 14-08: "limpiate los worktrees del proyecto que no se usen
y armame una estructura mas facil con symlinks".
Cleaning up is also the agent's job. Do not curate folders by hand.
New idea, new worktree. Never two tracks in the same folder, never a session without one.
